name: SkillUI
summary: CLI that reverse-engineers a website, repo or codebase into a Claude-ready skill folder with colors, type, spacing and components.
description: A local CLI (npx skillui) that crawls any URL, public git repo or local project and extracts its design system — color tokens, typography scale, spacing grid, fonts, animations, components and screenshots — into a folder Claude Code reads automatically (CLAUDE.md, SKILL.md, design tokens JSON, a .skill ZIP). Default mode is pure static analysis with no AI or API keys; ultra mode uses Playwright for scroll screenshots, hover/focus diffs, keyframe and layout detection.
contains: modes: default (static analysis), ultra (Playwright capture), dir (local scan), repo (clone and scan)
output: CLAUDE.md, SKILL.md, .skill ZIP, color tokens (CSS vars + JSON), typography scale, spacing grid
ultra extras: 7 scroll journey screenshots, hover/focus diffs, keyframe and flex/grid extraction, DOM fingerprinting
npm package skillui v1.3.4 with 25 releases; homepage skillui.vercel.app
requires Node 18+; Playwright for ultra mode; MIT license
